li: mitigation attempted: 1) toggle kernel_selection preference to avoid aggressive packed_short_kernel on that host, 2) increase batcher.max_seq_len to 65536 on prod-serving-3, 3) apply token-based rate limit at LB for the tenant id
li: commands run:
```bash
# pin kernel selection to avoid packed heuristic fallback
redwoodctl runtime set-config --host prod-serving-3 --kernel_selection.prefer_packed=false
# bump batcher max seq (temporary)
redwoodctl runtime set-config --host prod-serving-3 --batcher.max_seq_len=65536
# soft throttle tenant
redwoodctl tenancy throttle --tenant customer-phi --tokens-per-minute 20000
```
jon: after changes p95 on that host dropped from 2.3s -> ~150ms within two minutes, kvcache.evictions/sec back to baseline
